ops.old: Bite-size pieces of flathead in crisp breadcrumbs, fried golden and served with a homemade caper and pickle tartare and lemon wedges. Cut 500g flathead fillets into 3cm pieces. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g breadcrumbs. Shallow fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. For the tartare, mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.
